GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only averagely settled down 4-5 Lengths off the lead fence (800m), easing off Inside before Turn , Straightened Up all Clear wider out trying to run on, challenging late couldn't get there # sound/gave all

Blundered badly on jumping and Settled Down Mid Field 4 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 5 Lengths 2-3 Wide turning, steered widest and only a lane or So off outside rail Straightening Up , Made Good Ground in Straight hitting joint Lead at the 50m, raced head'n'head toi the line # lost in headbobber
Jumped only fairly, not bustled early & Settled Down 4 Lengths Two Wide , made no ground to turn, shifted wider and Made Ground to the line # ran on okay

Jumped okay, taken back & Settled Down 9 Lengths Two Wide , out 3 Wide middle stages, Drifted Back to 10 Lengths Two Wide turning, Hooked Out Wide Straightening Up and Made Some Ground in straight. [Stewards: Post-race vet exam did not reveal any abnormality.] # got too far back
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From a wide barrier was eased back to a position with cover in the early stages. Raced three wide, without cover, in the middle stages. Momentarily held up on heels approaching the 100m. A post-race veterinary examination of the gelding did not reveal any abnormality.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok Wide out settled down Two Wide third 4 Lengths (800m), moving closer To The Turn , Straightened Up second going after leader, both headed 200, rallied, none of them could match closing winner # no match last 100
Bit Slow Out Restrained from Outside Settled Down 5th 5 Lengths Not Enough Pace On to assist, asked to go at the 400m into 4th x 100m 2nd x line, # Sound eff/finale
Jumped Ok took sit 5th fence 3 Lengths 600m 5th 3 Lengths home turn 4th 2 Lengths took run 250m Kept Going Too Well # good ride/win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shortly after the start was carried wider out onto a runner. Laid in under pressure in the straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: No rush off a Wide gate drifted back last tacking on 8 Lengths (800m), brought very Wide before Turn , deepest 7 Wide trying to run on, battled ok # back/wide/ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Inconvenienced and taken wider near the 600m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok Wide out pushing on about to lob in Two Wide third 2 Lengths (1400m), edging closer in the run To The Turn , Straightened Up Quickly taking over, Quickly collared though, rallied soundly # sound on pace
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and bumped. Passing the 50m, steadied and consequently was not fully tested to the finish line.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow away. Recovered & raced behind Mid Field Two Wide (4L from lead). Held Ground midrace & improving slowly 3 Wide from 500m. Pushed to quicken Five Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 250m & worked to challenge leaders Five Wide @ 100m. Grabbed on line. # Grabbed on line.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin.  At the entrance to the straight was obliged to ease out around heels to continue to improve.
